title: Ode to Joy (theme of the finale of Symphony No. 9), arranged in six sections
licence: MIT for the encoding and the arrangement plan; the melody is public domain

perform.ritardando: from bar 89 the tempo falls by whole qpm each quarter to 1/2 of the start by the last quarter
perform.oct: octaves between the written pitch and where the arrangement sounds the melody; the Score witness checks the written pitch
perform.bar: bars count from 1 at the first intro bar; there is no upbeat
perform.kbar: the bar of the 16-bar theme the note comes from (1 to 16)
perform.tied: number of written heads merged into the note
perform.harmony: authored: D and A with G for colour; see score/ode.py HARM

form.label: the loom wakes: drone, heartbeat kick, clatter; no melody
statement 1, theme alone in the bass register: one indigo thread
statement 2, theme in the tenor with a counter-line: a silver thread joins
statement 3, theme in violins and lead synth: gold arrives
statement 4, tutti: every colour, the tapestry completes
final cadence, broadening ritardando into one big hit
